mapper.select: SELECT t1.id AS versionId, t1.version as version, t1.state as state, t1.remark as remark, t1.deployment_id as deploymentId, t2.name as name, t1.history_version as historyVersion FROM lm_flow_audit_version as t1 join lm_flow_audit AS t2 ON t2.id = t1.flow_audit_id WHERE t1.is_deleted = 0 and t2.is_deleted = 0 and flow_audit_id =#{id} order by t1.version desc
select version from lm_flow_audit_version where is_deleted = 0 and flow_audit_id =#{flowAuditId} order by version desc limit 1
